# Ordered procedure continuation

5. Establish the reader state before the procedure begins.
6. Verify the source document and continue the outer sequence.

   8. Nested verification starts at its source ordinal.
   9. Nested verification keeps its next source ordinal.

7. Record the first result and continue the outer sequence.
8. Check the second result against the expected reader state.
9. Confirm the device remains ready for the next operation.
10. Capture the visible page and compare it with the procedure record.
11. Keep the source number visible when this continuation reaches another page.
12. Repeat the check after the reader loads the next document section.
13. Verify that the page boundary does not restart the ordered marker sequence.
14. Record the continuation state before moving to the next step.
15. Confirm the rendered procedure remains readable on the host preview.
16. Compare the displayed result with the source procedure.
17. Save the final verification result for the next operator.
18. Continue the numbered procedure through the next page boundary.
19. Reopen the page and verify the continuation marker.
20. Confirm the next source step after the page turn.
21. Keep the procedure order stable in the host output.
22. Check the reader state before the next continuation.
23. Record the page-turn result in the procedure notes.
24. Compare the rendered marker with the source ordinal.
25. Verify that nested and outer sequences stay independent.
26. Continue the source procedure without renumbering.
27. Confirm the final document section is available.
28. Save the host preview for review.
29. Recheck the visible procedure state.
30. Confirm the ordered marker remains source-derived.
31. Record the completed continuation step.
32. Verify the next page has the expected procedure order.
33. Finish the numbered procedure with the source sequence intact.
34. Retain this final check for the operator handoff.
35. Complete the reader procedure.
